verdict_rules.MATCH: unit token coverage >= 0.8 and ocr extra ratio <= 0.2
verdict_rules.UNIT_SUBSET_PAGE_HAS_MORE: unit content present but the page carries additional tokens
verdict_rules.BLANK_PAGE: no ocr tokens and no unit tokens
verdict_rules.OCR_EMPTY_UNIT_HAS_TEXT: no ocr tokens while the unit claims text

limitations: Automated OCR comparison is a technical control; it does not replace the human documentary review required by WORKSHOP.md step 3.
OCR uses eng+fra only; other languages, stylized typography, diagrams and tables may degrade recognition.
Verdicts other than MATCH and BLANK_PAGE require human visual review before any unit is treated as verified evidence.
Source originals were read only; no source file was modified and no content left this machine.
